name: round 1: Lookups
tests: a bad command line exits 2 with a reason on stderr, nothing on stdout and no network call
a missing or malformed token, API root, RPC URL, chain or numeric setting exits 2 and contacts nothing
a bad network file exits 2 naming the bad entry's path
a node on another chain than CAIRN_CHAIN, or with an RPC spec below 0.10, exits 2 naming what it found
doctor prints the bot's username, the chain, the head block and the RPC spec version as one JSON line
a token Telegram rejects exits 3 with the token nowhere in the output, and a 409 conflict exits 1
tick answers every pending update in order within each chat and prints its JSON summary
a handled update is never answered twice, across ticks, restarts and a SIGKILL after its reply
registers at least its own commands with setMyCommands
in groups it answers only commands addressed to it, and ignores plain text and other bots' commands
/start and /help list the commands, say the replies are on-chain facts and not financial advice, say they cover public balances and transfers only, and link to adding the bot to a group
an unknown command gets a hint pointing to /help, and a malformed /start payload gets the plain welcome
/status shows the chain, the head block, its UTC time, the three gas prices in FRI and the node's spec version
/balance calls balance_of on every registry token in registry order and prints exact amounts, including a u256 above 2^128 and 1 wei
/balance falls back to balanceOf, flags an undeployed address, and shows an error for one failing token without hiding the others
an invalid address or hash is explained and makes no call about it
/tx shows finality, execution status, block, fee in STRK and an explorer link built from CAIRN_EXPLORER_URL
/tx of a reverted transaction shows its revert reason HTML-escaped, and an unknown hash says it was not found
addresses and hashes are accepted in any case, with or without leading zeros, and shown normalised
an RPC 429, 5xx or timeout is retried with backoff, then answered with a node-busy reply, and tick still exits 0
never makes more RPC calls in any one second than CAIRN_RPC_RPS
a Telegram 429 is retried after retry_after and the message is sent exactly once
a chat that blocked the bot is skipped, and other chats still get their answers
every message is valid Telegram HTML of at most 4096 characters, with outside text escaped and link previews off
run answers within 3 s, survives a node that is down for 2 s, and exits 0 within 3 s of SIGTERM during a long poll
never calls a Starknet write method or uses the pending or pre_confirmed tag, and contacts only TELEGRAM_API_ROOT and STARKNET_RPC_URL
the bot token and the secret in the RPC URL appear in no output, log, message, data file or request to the other host
writes only inside CAIRN_DATA, a directory of mode 700 with files of mode 600

the repository holds no Telegram token, private key or seed phrase, package.json has no dependency, and the committed network files are well-formed, with at least STRK, ETH, USDC, USDC.e, USDT and WBTC on SN_MAIN
